notes.title: Update v0.3.0.k_EA is now live!
notes.content:
Heat Death v0.3.0.k_EA is now live! This update focuses on improving the game balance based on community feedback. 

[b]What's New and Improved:[/b]

- [b]Challenge Adjustments:[/b] We’ve reduced enemy counts in both easy and normal difficulty levels to smooth out your gameplay experience.

- [b]Power Boost:[/b] Power cells now add 600 power capacity to your train (previously 500).

- [b]Enhanced Energy:[/b] Fission fuel generators now generate more power—+300 in easy mode and +240 in normal mode (up from +180).

- [b]Stronger Trains:[/b] Build 33% heavier trains with the same acceleration power.

- [b]Slower Deterioration:[/b] Modules now deteriorate slower in easy mode.

- [b]Warmer Interiors:[/b] Staying inside your train before constructing a heater is now 15% warmer.

- [b]Reduced Enemy Damage:[/b] Enemies deal less damage in both easy and normal modes, giving you a fighting chance.

- [b]Tougher Scrappers:[/b] Scrappers are now twice as durable in normal mode and completely indestructible in easy mode (unless you blast them directly!).

- [b]Solar Panel:[/b] The Solar panel produces 60 power under the starlight, and it won't deteriorate anymore. 

- [b]Blueprint balance:[/b] Blueprint requirement for certain modules and crafting recipes has been reduced.

- [b]Resources:[/b] We've added more materials to the stations. Also, it's more likely to find resources inside the lockers and enemies.

- [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We’ve fixed a few bugs affecting the battery charger and SeedEx placement.

- [b]Tweaks and More:[/b] Various tweaks and bug fixes to enhance your overall experience.

As always, we greatly appreciate your feedback and support. Thank you for being part of this journey with us!

notes.title: Early Access Launch!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to Early Access Launch day![/b]

The wait is over! Heat Death: Survival Train Early Access launches in just a few hours.

[b]What to Expect:[/b]
[list]
[*] An Expanded World: Explore a significantly larger map, three times the size of the public demo.
[*] A Customizable Arsenal: Upgrade your train with over 20 unique modules.
[*] Intense Combat: Face off against formidable enemies.
[*] Endless Possibilities: Immerse yourself in a thrilling, open-world adventure.
[/list]

Expect around 9 hours of gameplay on average, but your journey can last up to 10s of hours depending how robust you want your train and how much you discover of the world. Some professional players may beat the game a bit faster by just completing the essential tasks.

[b]Join Us for the Launch Stream![/b]
Be among the first to experience Early Access with us! Tune in to our special launch stream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/easy_ngp]Twitch[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7g1c-pOj1cc]YouTube[/url], or here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2662780/Heat_Death_Survival_Train/]Steam[/url]. Watch an official walkthrough, ask questions, and join the community.

[b]Launch Trailer[/b]
Learn more about the game before the launch with our brand-new trailer, premiering on YouTube 2 hours before Early Access release: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fYKXA6Ac-mw]Our YouTube Channel[/url]

[b]New public demo[/b]
Can’t wait to start your adventure? Download the new public demo now! It’s been updated with bug fixes and balance improvements.

[i]Your journey begins now...[/i]

notes.title: Major public demo update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781887/6e1ac10d70cc98a1340b77962ced9bce9dbed350.jpg[/img]We’re excited to announce that Heat Death v0.2.5.m_demo is live on the Steam public branch. 

[b]Here is what's new:[/b]
- [b]Airborne Scout Drones (New Enemy Type):[/b] The old scout drones have been replaced with new airborne drones that are faster and more challenging to overcome.
- [b]Rapid Burst (New Train Weapon):[/b] The Rapid Burst weapon uses train power instead of ammo. This weapon is designed to defend the train against the new drones.
- [b]Heat as a Resource:[/b] This community-suggested system now physically propagates heat on the train, meaning you must consider structural module insulation (e.g., walls are better insulators than windows). Certain modules (like engines) will produce small amounts of heat, but if you keep the doors open during a storm, all of it will dissipate.
- [b]Physical Train:[/b] Train physics is now more realistic. Each module has mass, and as you build them, the train becomes heavier, reducing its acceleration. Storms will also change the train's air drag, reducing its top speed during storms.
- [b]Fall Damage:[/b] You'll now take fall damage. Please let us know how this affects your play style.
- [b]Blueprint as a Resource:[/b] By popular demand, you can now unlock the modules you want instead of relying on random unlocks! Blueprints are now a collectible resource in your inventory.
- [b]New Structure Unlocking System:[/b] Structural modules are no longer available from the start. You’ll need to reach train stations to unlock them.
- [b]Fission Reactor (New Module):[/b] This powerful module generates energy using fuel. However, it’s radioactive while in operation and produces highly radioactive waste that must be stored or disposed of safely!
- [b]Module Deterioration:[/b] Modules like the Engine, Dynamo, and Fission Reactor will now wear down over time, adding a new challenge to maintaining your train.
- [b]Difficulty Levels and Game Balance:[/b] We’ve introduced new difficulty levels and rebalanced the game accordingly. You can adjust the difficulty level at any time during your adventure.
- [b]Compass:[/b] The HUD now has a new compass UI that shows enemies while you're in battle.
- [b]Infinite Player Inventory:[/b] Your inventory is now infinite! However, if you carry items beyond the limit, you won't be able to run or jump.
- [b]Other Changes and Bug Fixes[/b]

[b]Please note that: Due to the extensive changes, we had to reset the save files in this version, but you'll be able to load save files from this version in the first Early access release.[/b]

As always, we greatly appreciate your feedback and support. Thank you for being part of this journey with us!

We’re excited to announce that Heat Death v0.2.3.c_demo is live in the Steam open beta! In this update our focus is balancing the game and making it more enjoyable for everyone!

[b]Here’s what’s new:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Compass:[/b] The HUD now has a new compass UI that shows enemies while you're in battle.
[*] [b]Engine Deterioration:[/b] The engine no longer deteriorates while the train is stationary. Instead, each thrust level increases its deterioration. Additionally, when the engine is destroyed, the control panel will report it.
[*] [b]Easy Difficulty Level:[/b] We’ve adjusted the easy mode to make it easier.
[*] [b]Scrapper deterioration:[/b] Scrappers have 40% more durability.
[*]  [b]Rapid Burst SFX Bug Fix[/b]
[*] [b]Other Changes and Bug Fixes[/b]
[/list]

[b]P.S1:[/b] Heat Death: Survival Train Wiki is LIVE! :heart_eyes: . Find it [url=https://heat-death-survival-train.fandom.com/]here[/url]. 
Explore existing articles on key topics like [b]Area 87[/b], [b]Apocalyptic Triad[/b], and [b]Zoe's Grave[/b]. Join our vibrant community and contribute your knowledge to expand the wiki. Learn valuable [b]strategies [/b]to survive the harsh post-apocalyptic world. Discover [b]detailed descriptions[/b] and uses of various [b]objects[/b] and [b]items[/b] found in the game. Unravel the [b]secrets [/b]and [b]lore[/b] of Heat Death: Survival Train.

[b]P.S2:[/b] Show us if you love the wiki idea by creating wiki article, we will surely expand it then to an official self-hosted one.

[b]Here’s how you can opt-in:[/b]
[list]
[*] Go to your Steam library and right-click on “Heat Death: Survival Train Demo”.
[*] Select “Properties”, then navigate to “Betas”.
[*] From the drop-down menu, choose “open_beta”.
[*] Allow Steam to update the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Open beta v0.2.2.c Is now live!
notes.content:
The new open beta v0.2.2.c of "Heat Death: Survival Train Demo" is now available! 
Download it right now on Steam and dive into the thrilling survival experience that awaits you.

[b]Here’s what’s new:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Airborne Scout Drones (New Enemy Type):[/b] The old scout drones have been replaced with new airborne drones that are faster and more challenging to overcome.
[*] [b]Rapid Burst (New Train Weapon):[/b] The Rapid Burst weapon uses train power instead of ammo. This weapon is designed to defend the train against the new drones.
[*] [b]Heat as a Resource:[/b] This community-suggested system now physically propagates heat on the train, meaning you must consider structural module insulation (e.g., walls are better insulators than windows). Certain modules (like engines) will produce small amounts of heat, but if you keep the doors open during a storm, all of it will dissipate.
[*] [b]Physical Train:[/b] Train physics is now more realistic. Each module has mass, and as you build them, the train becomes heavier, reducing its acceleration. Storms will also change the train's air drag, reducing its top speed during storms.
[*] [b]Fall Damage:[/b] You'll now take fall damage. Please let us know how this affects your play style.
[*] [b]Blueprint as a Resource:[/b] By popular demand, you can now unlock the modules you want instead of relying on random unlocks! Blueprints are now a collectible resource in your inventory.
[*] [b]New Structure Unlocking System:[/b] Structural modules are no longer available from the start. You’ll need to reach train stations to unlock them.
[*] [b]Fission Reactor (New Module):[/b] This powerful module generates energy using fuel. However, it’s radioactive while in operation and produces highly radioactive waste that must be stored or disposed of safely!
[*] [b]Module Deterioration:[/b] Modules like the Engine, Dynamo, and Fission Reactor will now wear down over time, adding a new challenge to maintaining your train.
[*] [b]Difficulty Levels and Game Balance:[/b] We’ve introduced new difficulty levels and rebalanced the game accordingly. You can adjust the difficulty level at any time during your adventure.
[*] [b]Other Changes, Bug Fixes, and Tweaks[/b]
[/list]

[b]Please note that: Due to the extensive changes, we had to reset the save files in this version, but you'll be able to load save files from this version in the first Early access release.[/b]

Here’s how you can opt-in:
[list]
[*] Go to your Steam library and right-click on “Heat Death: Survival Train Demo”.
[*] Select “Properties”, then navigate to “Betas”.
[*] From the drop-down menu, choose “open_beta”.
[*] Allow Steam to update the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.12.j is now Live on public branch!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello survivors and Engineers![/h2]

We're thrilled to announce that Heat Death: Survival Train Demo [b]v0.1.12.j[/b] is now rolling out on the public branch of Steam! This update focuses on train customization, bringing new ways to customize your train by adding more modules, stickers, color changes, etc. 

For a full changelog, please refer to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2662780/view/4163093707450508827?l=english]this post[/url].

[b]Steam Deck and Linux users:[/b] You can use Proton 7.0-6 to avoid the repeated installation of prerequisites every time you start the game, or you can stay on Proton Experimental and either install or uninstall the recommended prerequisites every time the message pops out to bypass it. The game will start right after, either in the install or uninstall case.

notes.title: Open beta v0.1.12.e
notes.content:
Hello survivors and engineers!

We're rolling out the new open beta version of Heat Death for everyone to test and enjoy!

[b][h3]How to update to open beta?[/h3][/b]
Here's how you can opt-in:
- Go to your Steam library and right-click on "Heat Death: Survival Train Demo".
- Select "Properties", then navigate to "Betas".
- From the drop-down menu, choose "[b]open_beta[/b]".
- Let Steam take care of the game update.

[b][h3]What's new in v0.1.12.e?[/h3][/b]
Here's a rundown of the fresh changes in this version:
- [b]Prologue Redesign[/b]: We've given the Prologue a makeover, with updated quests and a rebalanced resource system.
- [b]New Build Menu[/b]: By pressing the "Q" button, you can access a wheel/grid menu for building, scrapping, and more.
- [b]Moving Module[/b]: The "Move" option in the build menu lets you shift modules without having to scrap them. Please note, scrapping modules will now only return a fraction of the resources used to build them.
- [b]Module Color Change[/b]: You can now add a dash of color to your train by changing the color of the structural elements!
- [b]Stickers[/b]: Add a personal touch to your train with stickers! You'll need a new resource called “Cartridge” for this.
- [b]Scout Drones[/b]: We've added two scout drones to the game! You'll need to either travel during the storm to avoid them or destroy them using the Icicle.
- [b]Module Repair[/b]: Scout drones can cause damage to your train. Any critically damaged modules won't function until they are repaired.
- [b]New Structural Modules[/b]: You can now add fences, half-walls, half-floors, and half-ceiling tiles to your train for more customization!
- [b]New Weapons System[/b]: Direct control of weapons is no longer available. Instead, you’ll need to build a new “Weapon Controller” module to operate them remotely. Don't forget to load them with ammo before you start firing!
- [b]Motion Sickness[/b]: We've added a new setting under the "Other" tab that allows you to disable camera shake, which could help reduce motion sickness for some players.
- [b]Performance Optimization[/b]: We've revamped part of the building system, which should now offer improved performance when building a train with numerous modules.
- [b]Various bug fixes, optimizations, and tweaks.[/b]

[b][h3]Public version (non-beta version) revert:[/h3][/b]
Due to VC++ Runtime issues for some players (mostly on Steam Deck), we've reverted the public version back to 0.1.7.i. If you played the public version in the last two days without any issues, feel free to opt into the open beta and continue playing.

We're always excited to hear your feedback and we thank you for being a part of this journey with us!

notes.title: Heat Death Open Beta Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello & Welcome!

In this very first blog post of "Heat Death: Survival Train" on Steam, we will tell you a quick description about Heat Death and also a brief history of it. If you just want the links, skip to the last paragraph "How to learn more?".

Please follow along, join the community and subscribe to our socials to get the latest videos and news about Heat Death and its updates.

[b]. What is Heat Death?[/b]

Heat Death is a sci-fi survival game where you can build your train and explore a frozen world! This train is not only your base but also your vehicle and weapon!

#Gameplay
You will explore a vast world with different biomes and weather conditions. You can craft and customize your train with various compartments and attachments. You must survive deadly storms, hostile bots and drones. Discover the planet’s secrets and the lore behind it. Heat Death is being developed using Unreal Engine 5 and offers stunning graphics only possible on latest version of engine.

#Environment
Heat Death takes place on an Eyeball planet, which is tidally locked to its star. One side of the planet always faces the star, and the other is always dark! Your goal is to travel to the dark side of this planet!

[b]. How heat death started? [/b]

The idea of a mobile-base survival game was on mind of our co-founder for a couple of months, until the first designs came to life in late 2022. Our indie team - with previous experience on mobile titles - was founded and the alpha version of demo was playable on itch.io in mid 2023. Heat Death received couple of updates and by the end of 2023, the first public demo was live on Steam. 

Since then, the updates have continued on two separate channels on Steam. One for the [i]"Beta"[/i] version of demo and another for the [i]"Public"[/i] version of demo.[b][/b]
The beta updates are gradually pushed to the public channel as they are getting polished and bug-fixed.
 
[b]. What is the current status?[/b]

Today we are publishing the new beta version openly, meaning that everyone can join and try it. This open beta has been worked on for a few months in the closed beta channel. For instructions on how to join the open beta, please follow along our next post here on Steam.

[b]. What's good?[/b]

Not only Heat Death is participating in Steam's Next Fest of June, but we have been chosen by Steam to be in the official Next Fest content produced and streamed by Steam. We are giving away more exclusive content during the Next Fest which begins on 11th of June 2024. Join our Discord server from [url=https://discord.gg/WH8RCvcnUQ]this link[/url] for more news on this. 

[b]. What's next?[/b]

The next phase after demo, will be an early access on Steam, which will be available sometime after the Next Fest and will include updates on a lot of things e.g. the environment, map and story. 

[b]. How to learn more? [/b]

First, get a first-hand experience by downloading the free demo and playing it for yourself. You can get it from:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2662780/Heat_Death_Survival_Train/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2662780/Heat_Death_Survival_Train/[/url]
or searching the steam for "Heat Death: Survival Train". 

Also make sure to join our Discord server from this link:
[url=https://discord.gg/WH8RCvcnUQ]https://discord.gg/WH8RCvcnUQ[/url]

On Discord, we post latest news and also the latest videos and live streams our community is continuously making about Heat Death.

Also subscribe to the official YouTube channel to get the latest trailers and gameplays straight from the development team. Subscribe from:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@HeatDeathGame]https://www.youtube.com/@HeatDeathGame[/url]

We hope to see you soon on our socials. Stay tuned for more blog post and updates.
